Date: Sun, 4 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency + 5xx spike — need immediate artifacts

Markus,

We're seeing a sustained latency increase and a spike in 5xxs affecting our payment flows starting ~2028-03-03 22:35 UTC. Tail p50/p95/p99 moved up ~3x and error rate jumped from 0.2% to ~2.8% over a 20m window. Our ops team needs the following to triage and for our internal audit:

- Inference request/response traces (token-level timing) for 2028-03-03 22:00:00 UTC -> 2028-03-03 23:00:00 UTC (we marked sample session ids: nb-session-7a9c, nb-session-7b1d)
- Server-side error traces for the same window (stack/error classes)
- Any KV-cache hit/miss samples for those sessions
- Confirmation of where the runtime logs will be staged and TTL for retention

We've attached a small perf sample that captures the point when errors started (perf-trace-20280303.json) — it's redacted on our side but should help pinpoint the spike.

This is priority for NovaBank compliance (they want an initial packet within the day). Please advise E2E how Redwood will handle transfer (S3 presigned vs secure share) and what PII/PII-adjacent fields you'll include or redact.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Senior SRE, NovaBank

Quick plan (initial):
1) Security-led extraction: Jonas, can you confirm the minimal artifact set and redaction policy?
2) Staging: we'll create a restricted S3 bucket under a temporary evidence prefix and give NovaBank access via short-lived roles/presigned URLs.
3) Manifest: we'll produce an evidence manifest (fields, hashes, TTL) and a COGS-style audit stamp.
4) Retention: propose 90-day TTL with option to extend under legal hold.

Timeline: initial manifest + one sample artifact in 2 hours; full export in < 8 hours pending approvals.

CCing Marissa for ops coordination and Jonas for security/process. If legal needs to sign a transfer consent, send it over — we can DocuSign.

-Markus

Markus / Marissa — outlined below is the secure evidence handling protocol to follow for this incident. We use this flow for exec escalations where external auditors may request chain-of-evidence.

Required minimal artifact set (redwood->customer):
- request/response traces (token-level timings) for requested session ids 
- server error logs (error class + stack snippets; full stack only if redacted of any PII)
- KV cache sample (list of keys hashed, hit/miss counters, not full key values)
- runtime metadata (node ids, model variant, kernel selection, sequence lengths)

Redaction policy:
- Never include raw user-entered content (prompt/completions) in the initial packet unless explicitly requested and signed-off by Legal.
- Replace any identifiers with salted hashes (salt recorded in manifest but not shared).
- Strip or pseudonymize IPs and PII; include a redaction log describing transformations.

Transfer mechanics:
- Create dedicated S3 evidence prefix: s3://evidence.redwood/incidents/NB-54321/20280304/
- Upload artifacts and manifest; provide NovaBank a presigned GET for each object (valid 48h).
- For extra assurance, enable bucket-level access logs and deliver an access-log snapshot in the evidence package.

Chain-of-custody & attestations:
- Produce evidence-manifest-template.csv (attached) listing artifact name, sha256, uploader, timestamp, redaction notes.
- Have NovaBank sign a short data-transfer acknowledgement (DocuSign link below).
- TTL: default 90 days; under legal hold we will freeze deletion and escalate to Legal + Compliance.

Attachments: evidence-manifest-template.csv (CSV), sample_manifest_filled_example.csv (for internal use only).
DocuSign transfer: https://docusign.net/redsigned/transfer-agreement/NB-54321

I'll lead extraction. Markus—please confirm whether we should include a limited sample of completion tokens (redacted) for debug; otherwise we'll omit prompts entirely.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas — that flow looks good. A few clarifications from compliance: 

- We do need token timing resolution and the error stack classes. For sample troubleshooting the team asks if you can include up to 10 completion tokens (redacted to token ids / pseudonyms) for the two sample sessions we provided.
- Confirm that presigned URLs will be TLS-only and IP-restricted to our office subnets if possible.
- If prompts are required later by our fraud team, we'll escalate via Legal and sign the DocuSign.

Can you confirm ETA for the initial manifest + one artifact? We need that to update our execs; they want the initial packet within the day.

Aisha
